finding: DOCKER-R01: original stop says one concurrent container, but preregistered K3 host-PID observation needs writer and read-only observer concurrently. run-001 exceeded original concurrent-container bound despite finite mechanism observations passing.
revision: Only K3 may use at most2 simultaneous containers, one existing writer and one trusted read-only host-PID observer; each128MiB, aggregate<=256MiB; seven total, other process/time/FD/network bounds unchanged. Other cases one at a time.
independent_reason: Actual OS observation must occur before writer termination, rather than accepting worker status claim; short-lived independent observer cannot examine a live namespace after it has gone.
not_changed: No property, expected process absence/object immutability, source hash, test data or prior records changed. Raw protocol/run-001 preserved. Reviewer records whether its independent run started before this amendment.
